endpoints.name: Ad Account
endpoints.description: One advertising account by id, with its budget and status.

endpoints.name: Ad Accounts
endpoints.description: The advertising accounts the credentials can reach, with name, type, status, currency and the reference the advertiser assigned. THE STARTING POINT: nearly every endpoint here takes a sponsored account URN, and LINKEDIN IDENTIFIES EVERYTHING BY URN rather than by bare id -- a string like urn:li:sponsoredAccount:12345 -- so an id lifted from one response usually needs wrapping before another will accept it.

endpoints.name: Ad Account User
endpoints.description: One user's access to one account. Requires both URNs.

endpoints.name: Authenticated Ad Account User
endpoints.description: The caller's own access records. Always the caller's, and the explanation for which accounts the rest of this connector can see.

endpoints.name: Ad Account Users by Accounts
endpoints.description: Access records across several named accounts at once. The efficient route for an agency managing many.

endpoints.name: Ad Account Users
endpoints.description: The users with access to one account and the role each holds. Requires the account URN.

endpoints.name: Campaign Group
endpoints.description: One campaign group by id.

endpoints.name: Campaign Groups
endpoints.description: The campaign groups within one account -- the budget and scheduling container above campaigns. Requires an account id. Budgets are frequently set here rather than per campaign, so campaign-level spend does not add up to the group's budget.

endpoints.name: Campaign
endpoints.description: One campaign by id, with its full targeting.

endpoints.name: Campaigns
endpoints.description: The campaigns within one account, with name, type, status, objective, the daily and total budget, bid, schedule and targeting criteria. Requires an account id. The unit most advertising questions are asked about. STATUS separates ACTIVE from PAUSED, DRAFT, ARCHIVED, COMPLETED and CANCELED, so an unfiltered spend or count includes campaigns that never ran.

endpoints.name: Creative
endpoints.description: One creative by id.

endpoints.name: Creatives
endpoints.description: The creatives -- the actual ads -- with their status, the campaign each belongs to, and the content they reference. Uses LinkedIn's search finder, so the account and campaign are given as SEARCH CRITERIA rather than as named parameters, which is why no account id appears in the path. A campaign holds several creatives, so creative-level performance is where a winning variant is identified.

endpoints.name: Ad Targeting Facets
endpoints.description: The targeting dimensions available -- industry, job function, seniority, skills, company size and the rest. The vocabulary campaigns are targeted in.

endpoints.name: Ad Targeting Entities
endpoints.description: The specific values within one targeting facet. Requires the facet. THE DECODER for targeting criteria: a campaign's targeting is a set of URNs, and this is what resolves them to names.

endpoints.name: Ad Targeting Entities by Similar Entities
endpoints.description: Targeting values similar to given ones. Audience expansion, for finding adjacent segments.

endpoints.name: Audience Counts
endpoints.description: The estimated size of an audience matching given targeting criteria. Planning rather than reporting -- it says how many people could be reached, not how many were.

endpoints.name: Ad Supply Forecasts
endpoints.description: The forecast impressions available for given targeting criteria. The inventory side of the same planning question.

endpoints.name: Video Ad
endpoints.description: One video ad by its post URN.

endpoints.name: Video Ads By Account
endpoints.description: The video creatives available to one account. Requires the account URN. Video is handled separately from other creative types in LinkedIn's model.

endpoints.name: Video Ads by Owner
endpoints.description: The video creatives owned by one organisation.

endpoints.name: Sponsored Conversation
endpoints.description: One sponsored conversation by id, with its flow.

endpoints.name: Sponsored Conversations
endpoints.description: The sponsored conversation ads -- LinkedIn's interactive message format -- by id. The message-based ad type, distinct from feed ads.

endpoints.name: Sponsored Message Contents
endpoints.description: The message steps within one sponsored conversation. Requires the conversation id. The conversation's actual content and branching.

endpoints.name: Sponsored Message Content
endpoints.description: One message step within a conversation.

endpoints.name: Ad InMail Content
endpoints.description: One InMail content by id.

endpoints.name: Ad InMail Contents
endpoints.description: The sponsored InMail message contents by id. The older single-message format.

endpoints.name: Member Sender Permissions by Account
endpoints.description: Which members may be used as the sender of sponsored messages for one account. Requires the account URN. Sponsored messages come from a person, so this is who the account may send as.

endpoints.name: Company Senders by Account
endpoints.description: Which companies may be used as the sender for one account.

endpoints.name: Sender Permissions by Member
endpoints.description: The accounts one member has granted sending permission to. The reverse view.

endpoints.name: Ad Analytics
endpoints.suffix: /rest/adAnalytics?q=analytics&pivot={Pivot}&timeGranularity={Time Granularity}&campaignType={Campaign Types?}&shares={Share URNs?}&campaigns={Campaign URNs?}&creatives={Creative URNs?}&campaignGroups={Campaign Group URNs?}&accounts={Account URNs?}&companies={Organization URNs?}&dateRange.start.year={Start Year?}&dateRange.start.month={Start Month?}&dateRange.start.day={Start Day?}&dateRange.end.year={End Year?}&dateRange.end.month={End Month?}&dateRange.end.day={End Day?}
endpoints.description: THE PERFORMANCE TABLE, and the one most questions here reduce to. Requires a pivot, a time granularity and a date range. Returns impressions, clicks, spend, conversions, video views and dozens of other metrics, PIVOTED by whatever dimension is asked for -- campaign, creative, account, company, job function, seniority, industry and more. THREE THINGS TO KNOW. The pivot IS the grouping: the same query pivoted differently is a different report, and only one pivot is allowed per request. Metrics must be named in the fields parameter or a minimal default set comes back. And demographic pivots are subject to a minimum-audience threshold -- LinkedIn withholds rows below it for privacy, so pivoted totals do not add up to the unpivoted figure.

endpoints.name: Ad Statistics
endpoints.suffix: /rest/adAnalytics?q=statistics&pivots={Pivots}&objectiveType={Objective Type}&timeGranularity={Time Granularity}&campaignType={Campaign Types?}&shares={Share URNs}&campaigns={Campaign URNs?}&creatives={Creative URNs?}&campaignGroups={Campaign Group URNs?}&accounts={Sponsored Account URNs?}&companies={Organization URNs?}&dateRange.start.year={Start Year?}&dateRange.start.month={Start Month?}&dateRange.start.day={Start Day?}&dateRange.end.year={End Year?}&dateRange.end.month={End Month?}&dateRange.end.day={End Day?}
endpoints.description: The same analytics addressed by the statistics finder, taking multiple pivots and an objective type. Use it where a breakdown needs two dimensions at once, which the single-pivot analytics finder cannot express.

endpoints.name: Pricing Insights by Criteria
endpoints.suffix: /rest/adBudgetPricing?q=criteriaV2&campaignType={Campaign Type}&account={Sponsored Account URN}&bidType={Bid Type}&currency={ISO Currency Code?}&countryCode={ISO Country Code}&matchType={Match Type}&targetingCriteria={Targeting Criteria}&dailyBudget={Daily Budget}&objectiveType={Objective Type}&optimizationTargetType={Optimization Target Type}
endpoints.description: The estimated bid range for a given campaign type and targeting. Forward-looking market pricing, used before spending rather than after.

endpoints.name: Insight Tags by Account
endpoints.description: The LinkedIn Insight Tags in one account -- the tracking pixels installed on the advertiser's site. Requires the account URN. NO TAG MEANS NO CONVERSION DATA, so this is the first thing to check when conversions are absent.

endpoints.name: Insight Tag
endpoints.description: One insight tag by id.

endpoints.name: Insight Tag Permissions by Account
endpoints.description: Who may use one account's insight tags. Relevant on shared or agency-managed tags.

endpoints.name: Insight Tag Domains by Account
endpoints.description: The domains an account's insight tags are firing on. Where tracking is actually installed, as opposed to where it was intended.

endpoints.name: Conversion
endpoints.description: One conversion definition by id.

endpoints.name: Conversions
endpoints.description: Several conversion definitions by id.

endpoints.name: Conversions by Account
endpoints.description: The conversion definitions in one account -- the actions on the advertiser's own site that count as success, with their type and attribution window. Requires the account URN. Conversion COUNTS appear in analytics; what a conversion MEANS is defined here.

endpoints.name: Campaign Conversion
endpoints.description: One campaign-to-conversion association.

endpoints.name: Campaign Conversions
endpoints.description: Several campaign-to-conversion associations by URN.

endpoints.name: Campaign Conversions by Campaign
endpoints.description: Which conversions are attached to which campaigns. The link that decides what a campaign's conversion count is counting.

endpoints.name: Campaign Recommendations
endpoints.description: LinkedIn's suggested changes to named campaigns -- budget, bid and targeting adjustments. Advice, not data.

endpoints.name: Campaign Insights
endpoints.description: LinkedIn's own generated observations about named campaigns. Interpretation rather than measurement.

endpoints.name: Third-Party Tracking Tag
endpoints.description: One third-party tracking tag by id.

endpoints.name: Third-Party Tracking Tags by Creative
endpoints.description: The external tracking tags attached to one creative. Requires the creative URN. Third-party verification, which produces figures that will not match LinkedIn's own.

endpoints.name: Ad Forms by Account
endpoints.description: The lead generation forms in one account. Requires the account URN. Lead gen forms collect contact details in-platform, so they are the conversion mechanism for lead campaigns.

endpoints.name: Ad Form
endpoints.description: One lead gen form by id, with its questions.

endpoints.name: Ad Forms
endpoints.description: Several lead gen forms by id.

endpoints.name: Ad Form Question
endpoints.description: One question within a form. Requires the form URN and question id. The decoder for a response's answers, which reference question ids.

endpoints.name: Ad Form Responses by Account
endpoints.suffix: /rest/adFormResponses?q=account&account={Sponsored Account URN}&campaign={Campaign URN?}&creative={Creative URN?}&form={Form URN?}&leadType={Lead Type?}&timeRange.start={Start Time?:Unix Timestamp}&timeRange.end={End Time?:Unix Timestamp}
endpoints.description: THE LEADS THEMSELVES -- every form submission in one account, with the answers given and the campaign that produced them. Requires the account URN. The commercial output of a lead gen campaign, and the only place the actual contact details are.

endpoints.name: Ad Form Response
endpoints.description: One form response by id. Requires the account URN.

endpoints.name: Ad Form Responses
endpoints.description: Several form responses by id.

endpoints.name: DMP Segments
endpoints.description: Several segments by id.

endpoints.name: DMP Segment
endpoints.description: One segment by id, with its size and status.

endpoints.name: DMP Segments by Account
endpoints.description: The matched audience segments in one account -- uploaded contact lists, website retargeting audiences and lookalikes. Requires the account URN. Carries the match rate, which is what determines whether an uploaded list is usable: a low match rate means most of the uploaded people were not found on LinkedIn.

endpoints.name: DMP Segment Destination
endpoints.description: One segment destination.

endpoints.name: DMP Segment Destinations
endpoints.description: Where one segment is shared to. Requires the segment id.

endpoints.name: DMP Segment Lookalikes
endpoints.description: The lookalike audiences derived from one segment. Requires the segment id. Audience expansion built on a seed list.

endpoints.name: Ad Segment Status
endpoints.description: The processing status of one audience segment. Segments take time to build after upload, so this explains a segment that exists but cannot yet be targeted.

endpoints.name: Organization
endpoints.description: One organisation by id -- the company page behind an advertiser. Carries the name, vanity name, description, industry, size and locations.

endpoints.name: Organization by Email Domain
endpoints.description: The organisation matching an email domain. The lookup from a company's mail domain to its LinkedIn page.

endpoints.name: Organization Follower Count
endpoints.description: The follower count of one organisation. Requires the organisation URN. A single number and the cheapest audience-size check.

endpoints.name: Organization Brand
endpoints.description: One brand page by id.

endpoints.name: Organization Brands by Organization
endpoints.description: The brand pages under one parent organisation. Large companies run several brand pages, so a total for the company means summing them.

endpoints.name: Organization Brands by Vanity Name
endpoints.description: A brand page by its vanity URL name.

endpoints.name: Follower Statistics
endpoints.description: Follower counts and gains for one organisation, broken down by seniority, function, industry, staff count and country. THE AUDIENCE COMPOSITION TABLE -- who follows the page, as opposed to how many. Subject to the same minimum-threshold suppression as ad demographics.

endpoints.name: Organization Page Statistics
endpoints.description: Page views and unique visitors for one organisation's page, by section and by viewer demographic, over a time range. The organic counterpart to ad analytics.

endpoints.name: Brand Page Statistics
endpoints.description: The same page statistics for one brand page. Requires the brand URN.

endpoints.name: Share Statistics
endpoints.description: Engagement statistics for one organisation's posts -- impressions, clicks, likes, comments, shares and engagement rate. ORGANIC PERFORMANCE, which the advertising analytics does not cover: a company's own posting reach lives here.

endpoints.name: UGC Posts by URN
endpoints.description: One post by its URN, in a given view context.

endpoints.name: UGC Posts
endpoints.description: Several posts by URN.

endpoints.name: UGC Posts by Authors
endpoints.description: The posts authored by named people or organisations. Requires the author URNs. The content table for organic activity.

endpoints.name: UGC Posts by Group
endpoints.description: The posts within a LinkedIn group. Requires the group URN.

endpoints.name: UGC Posts by Permalink Suffixes
endpoints.description: Posts looked up by the suffix of their public URL. The route in when only a shared link is known.

endpoints.name: Share
endpoints.description: One share by id.

endpoints.name: Shares by Owner
endpoints.description: The shares posted by one owner. Requires the owner URN. Shares are the older post model that coexists with UGC posts, so a complete content history may need both.

endpoints.name: Shares
endpoints.description: Several shares by id.

endpoints.name: Activities
endpoints.description: Activity records by id. The wrapper LinkedIn uses around shares and posts in some contexts.

endpoints.name: Social Actions Summary
endpoints.description: The like, comment and share counts on one post, share or comment. Requires its URN. The engagement totals; the individual actions are separate endpoints.

endpoints.name: Likes
endpoints.description: The individual likes on one post or comment. Requires its URN. Who engaged, as opposed to how many.

endpoints.name: Comments
endpoints.description: The comments on one post, with their authors and text. Requires the post URN. The qualitative response to content, which no engagement count conveys.

endpoints.name: Social Metadata Summary
endpoints.description: The social metadata of one entity -- comment and reaction settings and totals. Requires its URN.

endpoints.name: Social Metadata Summaries
endpoints.description: The same for several entities at once.

endpoints.name: Reactions
endpoints.description: The reactions on one post, by reaction type -- like, celebrate, support, insightful and the rest. Requires the post URN. Finer than a like count, and the reaction mix says something a total cannot.

endpoints.name: Video Analytics
endpoints.description: The view statistics of one video post -- views, view rate and completion. Requires the post URN. Video completion is measured here rather than in the general analytics endpoint.

endpoints.name: Current User Profile
endpoints.description: The member profile the credentials belong to. One record, always the caller. Note LinkedIn restricts profile fields severely: what comes back depends on the permissions granted, and most fields available in the interface are not available through the API at all.

endpoints.name: User Profile
endpoints.description: One member profile by id. Subject to the same severe field restrictions -- LinkedIn does not permit general profile lookup, so this works only for members who have authorised the application.

endpoints.name: User Profiles
endpoints.description: Several member profiles by id, with the same restrictions.
